inspection_method: Recursively inventory every page/Form font resource including unused Forms; independently enumerate every indirect Font object; validate every Tf resource name in its local/inherited context; extract actual characters with pdfplumber.
source_prevention_caveat: BaseDocTemplate._makeCanvas passes initialFontName=self.initialFontName (default None), overriding functools.partial Canvas defaults. Set initialFontName directly on SimpleDocTemplate (or overwrite None explicitly in canvasmaker), and set table FONTNAME.
scope_limit: Pixel equality is root separate check; this report checks all fonts and references.
